name: hendamm-exec-pipeline-task
description: Extension to exec pipeline in azure devops
helpMarkDown: Extension to exec pipeline in azure devops
author: Henry Mosquera

inputs.name: azureDevopsPath
inputs.label: Azure Devops Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the service connection for azure devops (if you want to use it).

inputs.name: targetOrganization
inputs.label: Target Organization (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Organization that owns the pipeline. Defaults to the current one (or the one in the service connection). A different organization requires a service connection or a Personal Access Token.

inputs.name: targetProject
inputs.label: Target Project (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Project that owns the pipeline. Defaults to the current project (or the one in the service connection). With System.AccessToken, the Build Service identity needs access to that project.

inputs.name: personalAccessToken
inputs.label: Personal Access Token (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only without a service connection, to execute pipelines in another organization. Pass a secret variable, e.g. $(myPat). Needs Build (Read & execute).

inputs.name: branch
inputs.label: Branch
inputs.helpMarkDown: The branch to execute the pipeline.

inputs.name: pipelineID
inputs.label: Pipeline ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: The ID of the pipeline to execute (you can find it in the URL). Required unless Pipeline Name is set; if both are set the ID is used.

inputs.name: pipelineName
inputs.label: Pipeline Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Alternative to Pipeline ID. Name of the pipeline; if several pipelines share the name, prefix it with the folder (folder\name).

inputs.name: reason
inputs.label: Reason for execution
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the reason for the execution.

inputs.name: isParameter
inputs.label: Extra Data is Parameter
inputs.helpMarkDown: If checked, the extra data will be passed as parameters to the pipeline instead of variables.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.label: Parameters or Variables to pass to the pipeline (JSON)
inputs.helpMarkDown: If you want to pass parameters or variables to the pipeline, you can use this field. The format is JSON (e.g. {"key": "value"}).

inputs.name: parametersFile
inputs.label: Parameters file (JSON)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to a JSON file (object) with parameters/variables, relative to the working directory. Values in the inline field override the file.

inputs.name: onlyExecution
inputs.label: Just execute the pipeline
inputs.helpMarkDown: If checked, the pipeline will be executed without waiting for the result.

inputs.name: pollIntervalSeconds
inputs.label: Polling interval (seconds)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Seconds between status checks while waiting for the pipeline (5-300). Default 10.

inputs.name: timeoutMinutes
inputs.label: Wait timeout (minutes)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum minutes to wait for the executed pipeline. 0 means no limit (default). On timeout this task fails but the executed pipeline keeps running.

inputs.name: cancelOnAbort
inputs.label: Cancel executed pipeline on cancel/timeout
inputs.helpMarkDown: When waiting, cancel the executed pipeline if this task is canceled or the wait timeout is reached.

outputVariables.name: runUrl
outputVariables.description: Web URL of the executed run/build

outputVariables.name: runResult
outputVariables.description: Final result (succeeded, partiallySucceeded, failed, canceled, timeout). Only set when waiting for the pipeline
